choice: Evaluated controller selects one verified historical code hash from dev evidence; trusted bridge locks method before final refit. No operator substitution or hidden-score choice.
comparison: No B/C/G treatment effect, architecture winner, power, ResearchDone, P1/P2 or native-construction inference from P0.
continuation: One fresh context after actual initial termination and exact handoff. At most remaining1dev opportunity plus1finalrefit; no budget or state reset.
controller: C0 compulsory evidence/identity/budget/recovery checks; no graph efficacy treatment.
cost: Preparation and verification nonzero; no new paid provider/cloud or unbounded billing. Existing subscription credentials remain task-local and uninspected.
final_assessment: One externally trusted original-unit MAE calculation only after final prediction lock and controller termination. Targets not mounted in generated code, no final score returned for reselection.
foreground_policy: Root execution is foreground/serial; no uncollected background controller jobs. Native ORX lifecycle still requires an explicitly compatible orchestration path before P0 admission.
initial_context: At most2 eligible dev results; no third dev or final refit; finish with research.md saved.
model_method_freedom: Initial RF is unmeasured source scaffold. Controller may choose/modify preprocessing,features,estimator and hyperparameters within fixed libraries. No predetermined RF/Ridge/GB menu or root candidate choice.
original_result_rule: Actual ORX native commit/run/source identity and opened output receipts are required. Missing/partial/UNKNOWN fail closed; no blind retries or --force.
scientific_lifecycle: Only documented ORX experiment/run/status/cancel/log surfaces; no competing supervisor or status registry.

tokens.enforcement: Between completed messages and sampled observer; no hard in-flight cap.

unit: One development programme; two sequential controller contexts are nested events, not replications.
